title: Vijayanagar Administration
definition: A highly centralized yet segmentary state structure characterized by the Nayankara system, military-feudal bureaucracy, and a sophisticated revenue administration that integrated agrarian expansion with temple-centric socio-economic control.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Prelims regarding administrative terminology (Nayaka, Ayagar) and in Mains for its unique military-feudal synthesis and impact on South Indian socio-economic history.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Vijayanagar Administration.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Medieval Indian Polity
